grammar_title: 非谓语作定语/状语/补语(doing · done · to do 综合)
source: 外研社新标准选择性必修第三册 Unit 6 First Snow:非谓语动词作定语/状语/宾语补足语(doing/done/to do)。句子围绕初雪·冬天·童年主题,语法点自然成立;4 选项为同一或相近动词的不同非谓语形式,凭主动/被动·分词种类判断,答案唯一;零术语、应用型。

points.point: 非谓语作定语(the falling snow / the frozen lake / the first to go)
points.overview: 名词与动词是主动/进行关系 → 现在分词(the falling snow);被动/完成关系 → 过去分词(the frozen lake, the branches bent by the snow);表'将要做、可去做'→ 不定式(the first child to see the snow, a place to sit)。

points.point: 非谓语作状语(主动 -ing / 被动 -ed)
points.overview: 分词作状语,其逻辑主语 = 主句主语;主句主语主动发出动作用现在分词(Looking out of the window, I saw …),承受动作用过去分词(Covered with snow, the fields looked white)。

points.point: 非谓语作宾语补足语(see sb doing / find sth done / want sb to do)
points.overview: see/hear/watch/feel/find 等 + 宾语 + 现在分词(动作进行:see sb doing)或过去分词(被动:find sth done);want/ask/tell/expect/cause/force 等 + 宾语 + 不定式 to do。

questions.stem: The ____ children in the yard threw snowballs at each other.
questions.explanation: 孩子主动发出'笑'的动作、与名词同时进行 → 现在分词 laughing 作定语。

questions.stem: The girl ____ a snowman in the garden waved at us happily.
questions.explanation: girl 主动'堆'雪人、后带宾语 snowman,主句谓语是 waved → 现在分词 building 作定语。

questions.stem: A boy ____ a snowball at his friend laughed with delight.
questions.explanation: boy 主动'扔'、带宾语 a snowball → 现在分词 throwing 作定语。

questions.stem: The man ____ the snow off his coat smiled at the children.
questions.explanation: man 主动'拍掉'雪、带宾语,主句谓语 smiled → 现在分词 brushing。

questions.stem: The woman ____ down the lane towards the church looked up at the sky.
questions.explanation: 主句谓语已是 looked,空处只能作定语;woman 主动'走' → 现在分词 walking。

questions.stem: The lake, ____ solid by the night's cold, shone like glass in the sun.
questions.explanation: lake 被寒冷'冻结'(by 短语表被动)→ 过去分词 frozen 作定语。

questions.stem: The dining-room window, ____ into a lovely Japanese print, glowed softly.
questions.explanation: window 被'变成'一幅画(被动)→ 过去分词 transformed。

questions.stem: The little plum tree, ____ in soft white snow, stood in full sunlight.
questions.explanation: tree 被雪'裹住'(被动)→ 过去分词 wrapped。

questions.stem: The whole village, ____ under a thick white blanket, lay completely silent.
questions.explanation: village 被雪'藏起'(被动)→ 过去分词 hidden。

questions.stem: The branches, ____ down by the weight of the snow, almost touched the ground.
questions.explanation: branches 被雪的重量'压弯'(by 短语表被动)→ 过去分词 bent。

questions.stem: Leaves ____ to the ground by the cold wind lay frozen on the grass.
questions.explanation: leaves 被风'吹'到地上(by 短语表被动)→ 过去分词 blown。

questions.stem: The garden path, ____ by fresh snow, had completely disappeared by morning.
questions.explanation: path 被雪'覆盖'(by 短语表被动)→ 过去分词 covered。

questions.stem: The roofs, ____ thick with heavy snow, looked as if they might break.
questions.explanation: roofs 被雪'压载'(被动)→ 过去分词 loaded。

questions.stem: The little stream, half ____ by ice, still sang quietly under the trees.
questions.explanation: stream 被冰'挡住'(by 短语表被动)→ 过去分词 blocked。

questions.stem: The first child ____ the fresh snow that morning shouted with delight.
questions.explanation: the first + 名词后接不定式表'第一个去做……的'→ to see。

questions.stem: Winter is the best time of year ____ snowballs with your friends.
questions.explanation: time/the best time 后用不定式表'用来做……的'→ to throw。

questions.stem: She was the only one ____ outside into the freezing storm.
questions.explanation: the only one 后接不定式表'唯一去做……的'→ to go。

questions.stem: He looked for a quiet place ____ and watch the falling snow.
questions.explanation: a place 后用不定式表'可去做……的地方'→ to sit。

questions.stem: There was still one more snowy hill ____ before we reached home.
questions.explanation: 名词后接不定式表'尚需去做的'→ one more hill to climb。

questions.stem: The children had a whole free afternoon ____ in the deep fresh snow.
questions.explanation: an afternoon 后用不定式表'用来做……的'→ to play。

questions.stem: ____ along the snowy lane, I met an old school friend of mine.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 I 主动'走'→ 现在分词 Walking 作状语。

questions.stem: ____ with deep snow, the open fields looked like a vast white sea.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 fields 被雪'覆盖'(被动)→ 过去分词 Covered 作状语。

questions.stem: ____ at the magic world outside, the children talked away excitedly.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 children 主动'看'→ 现在分词 Looking。

questions.stem: ____ by the beauty of the first snow, I quite forgot about the cold.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 I 被景色'打动'(被动)→ 过去分词 Amazed。

questions.stem: ____ the snow falling steadily outside, we decided to stay at home.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 we 主动'看见'→ 现在分词 Seeing。

questions.stem: ____ deep in the snow, the small car simply could not move at all.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 car 被雪'埋住'(被动)→ 过去分词 Buried。

questions.stem: The little boy ran outside, ____ loudly with excitement.
questions.explanation: 伴随状语,boy 主动'喊'→ 现在分词 shouting。

questions.stem: ____ to find the whole world white, I rushed straight to the window.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 I 感到'惊讶'(被动/情感)→ 过去分词 Surprised。

questions.stem: ____ warmly in coats and hats, the children went out to play.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 children 被'穿戴'好(被动)→ 过去分词 Dressed。

questions.stem: ____ the sharp cold wind on her face, she pulled her coat tighter.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 she 主动'感到'→ 现在分词 Feeling。

questions.stem: ____ steadily for several hours, the snow finally stopped around noon.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 snow 主动'落'、持续进行 → 现在分词 Falling。

questions.stem: ____ by the warm fire, we watched the snow through the window.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 we 主动'坐'→ 现在分词 Sitting。

questions.stem: ____ by the bright morning sun, the snow slowly began to melt.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 snow 被太阳'晒暖'(by 短语表被动)→ 过去分词 Warmed。

questions.stem: ____ his cold nose against the glass, the boy watched the white flakes.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 boy 主动'贴'、带宾语 his nose → 现在分词 Pressing。

questions.stem: ____ from the long walk through the snow, they fell asleep at once.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 they 感到'精疲力竭'(被动/情感)→ 过去分词 Exhausted。

questions.stem: ____ the children playing happily below, the old man smiled to himself.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 the old man 主动'看'→ 现在分词 Watching。

questions.stem: ____ under the deep fresh snow, the narrow garden path was hard to find.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 path 被雪'藏住'(被动)→ 过去分词 Hidden。

questions.stem: ____ slowly down from the grey sky, the snowflakes covered everything.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 snowflakes 主动'飘落'→ 现在分词 Drifting。

questions.stem: ____ at the falling snow, he suddenly remembered a rhyme from childhood.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 he 主动'凝视'→ 现在分词 Gazing。

questions.stem: ____ tightly in a warm scarf, she stepped out into the winter storm.
questions.explanation: 主句主语 she 被围巾'裹住'(被动)→ 过去分词 Wrapped。

questions.stem: From my study I can see the children ____ their noses against the window.
questions.explanation: see + 宾语 children + 主动且进行的动作(带宾语 noses)→ 现在分词 flattening 作宾补。

questions.stem: We watched the soft snow ____ quietly past the bright street lamp.
questions.explanation: watch + 宾语 snow + 正在进行的动作 → 现在分词 falling 作宾补。

questions.stem: All night I could hear the cold wind ____ around the old empty house.
questions.explanation: hear + 宾语 wind + 主动进行的动作 → 现在分词 blowing 作宾补。

questions.stem: She saw her little brother ____ a snowball at the front door.
questions.explanation: see + 宾语 brother + 主动且带宾语的动作 → 现在分词 throwing 作宾补。

questions.stem: Through the window we watched the children ____ happily in the deep snow.
questions.explanation: watch + 宾语 children + 正在进行的动作 → 现在分词 playing 作宾补。

questions.stem: I noticed the bare plum tree ____ gently in the cold winter wind.
questions.explanation: notice + 宾语 tree + 主动进行的动作 → 现在分词 bending 作宾补。

questions.stem: He could feel the soft snowflakes ____ on his warm red cheeks.
questions.explanation: feel + 宾语 snowflakes + 正在进行的动作 → 现在分词 melting 作宾补。

questions.stem: When I woke up, I found the whole garden ____ in deep white snow.
questions.explanation: find + 宾语 garden + 被动状态(被雪埋)→ 过去分词 buried 作宾补。

questions.stem: We found the small pond completely ____ over by early next morning.
questions.explanation: find + 宾语 pond + 被动状态(被冻住)→ 过去分词 frozen 作宾补。

questions.stem: I saw the dining-room window ____ into a lovely Japanese print.
questions.explanation: see + 宾语 window + 被动结果(被变成)→ 过去分词 transformed 作宾补。

questions.stem: She found her warm gloves ____ somewhere under the deep snow.
questions.explanation: find + 宾语 gloves + 被动状态(被弄丢)→ 过去分词 lost 作宾补。

questions.stem: We saw several thin branches ____ by the great weight of the snow.
questions.explanation: see + 宾语 branches + 被动结果(被压断,by 短语)→ 过去分词 broken 作宾补。

questions.stem: He wanted the snowy path ____ before the guests finally arrived.
questions.explanation: want + 宾语 path + 被动(路被清理)→ 过去分词 cleared 作宾补。

questions.stem: By noon we found most of the snow ____ away by the warm bright sun.
questions.explanation: find + 宾语 snow + 被动结果(被晒化,by 短语)→ 过去分词 melted 作宾补。

questions.stem: My mother told us ____ our wet boots before coming back inside.
questions.explanation: tell sb to do sth → 宾补用不定式 to clean。

questions.stem: The freezing weather caused the whole lake ____ hard overnight.
questions.explanation: cause sth to do sth → 宾补用不定式 to freeze。

questions.stem: We expected the heavy snow ____ for several more cold days.
questions.explanation: expect sth to do sth → 宾补用不定式 to last。

questions.stem: The teacher asked the children ____ quietly at the falling snow.
questions.explanation: ask sb to do sth → 宾补用不定式 to look。

questions.stem: I would like you ____ this old winter rhyme together with me.
questions.explanation: would like sb to do sth → 宾补用不定式 to repeat。

questions.stem: The deep snow forced many drivers ____ their cars at home that day.
questions.explanation: force sb to do sth → 宾补用不定式 to leave。
